goal: RA-8457: platform admin can verify or reject contractor certifications; rejected edits return to PENDING; profile isVerified derived in one owner (C4 uses the repo type-check runner)

criteria.text: Admin verify route: non-platform-admin gets 403; platform admin moves PENDING to VERIFIED with verifiedAt/verifiedBy set; REJECTED stores notes; non-PENDING refused; profile isVerified recomputed
Contractor edit of a REJECTED certification returns it to PENDING and clears the old decision
Public profile returns VERIFIED certifications and not PENDING ones
